project.title: Senseless
project.description: Senseless is an educational story-driven game for ages 7 and up that brings together fields like chemistry, physics, math, philosophy, and medicine. The story is set in an infinite white void, where a god-like being guides a curious Inchoate on a journey to recover lost powers and uncover the history of the world. It is designed as a casual game that players can enjoy daily on PC and mobile, and it is currently in development.

project.title: Edutainment YouTube Channel and Social Media Content
project.description: This project is an educational channel and social media content made to teach many people about various fields of knowledge. Creating it also lets me learn those fields myself since I have to understand a concept well before I can explain it. It is also meant to earn money and it is currently an idea in the planning stage.

project.title: Untitled Philippines Story
project.description: This is a story set in the Philippines in the 2050s to 60s, following a stranded Japanese assassin and a Filipino companion as they travel to Manila. It aims to introduce foreigners to Philippine culture while teaching topics like medicine, biology, gravity, and space through the characters. It is currently an idea in the planning stage and does not have a final title yet.
